description:
Damage calculator data: weapons, ammo, muzzle attachments, armour and suits. The data behind https://rust.wiki/calculators/damage: `weapons` (guns and bows whose ammo the model covers),
`ammo` per ammo family as [name, damage multiplier, headshot multiplier, pellets override], `attachments`
(muzzle damage multipliers), `armour` (projectile protection %, `slot` and `layer`: clothing goes under, armour
over, dual takes both, single = hands/feet), `suits`, `zones` (hit areas and multipliers; `low` = low confidence),
`presets`, `rules` and `caveats`.
name: get_damage_data
title: Damage calculator data: weapons, ammo, muzzle attachments, armour and suits
